values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block for one night (read 2026-11-10): PA residents $10.00 a night ($70.00 a week), non-residents $15.00 a night ($105.00 a week), 'Reservation Fees $6.50', and 'Any applicable taxes will be shown within the shopping cart' (the cart needs a login and was not opened). https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents ... effective as of November 3, 2022'); Michaux camping brochure, elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3562328 ('DCNR charges a $6.50 non-refundable transaction fee on all reservations and registrations')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

values.note: Closed for the Michaux winter camping season, which runs from the third Sunday after Thanksgiving (13 December in 2026, so the closing date moves a few days each year) to April 1.

season.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/michaux/camping ('The winter camping season in Michaux State Forest annually begins the third Sunday following Thanksgiving and ends April 1. During the winter camping season, the following designated motorized campsites are available for reservation: Campsite #1 -- Big Flat Parking Lot; Campsite #2 -- Piney Mountain Parking Lot; Campsite #21 -- Teaberry Parking Lot; Campsite #22 -- Peggy's Hill Parking Lot. All other campsites are closed.'); Michaux State Forest Camping Map and Brochure (elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3562328) (roadside campsites: 'Closed for winter from the 3rd Sunday following Thanksgiving to April 1st'); ReserveAmerica calendar for siteId 29397 shows 'Not Available' from 2026-12-15 to 2026-12-31; read 2026-11-10

note: A small gravel parking lot in the woods, about 20 m across on imagery, on the left 700 ft up Swift Run Road from Old Forge Road; the booked site is the lot itself, and DCNR sizes it for one trailer. A trail leaves the back of it and the lot also serves trail users, so 'other forest users may be encountered'. Suitable for camping with horses; stone fire ring. Old Forge Road is paved; the last 700 ft on Swift Run Road are compacted gravel. No toilet; pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 45 ft, pull-through, gravel; no ATV, 4WD or 'not recommended' text. CHANGED: season from year-round to April 1 - mid-December (DCNR closes every Michaux roadside site except four named parking-lot areas for the winter; Swift Run is not one of the four). Fees confirmed and the $6.50 reservation fee added; booking and hookups confirmed; toilets/water written as none. Imagery: bright gravel lot with the pin on it (the page's own coordinates, 39.80235,-77.47972, fall about 30 m north-east under canopy; pin not moved). NHD: no water within 200 m. Phone 717-352-2211 confirmed.
flags: Season conflict between two official sources: the ReserveAmerica page says 'Status: Open year round' and its calendar shows the site 'Not Available' only from 15 to 31 December 2026, then 'Available' again from 1 January through March 2027; DCNR's Michaux camping page and brochure say every campsite except the four winter parking-lot areas is closed from the third Sunday after Thanksgiving to April 1. I wrote the DCNR statement (the engine's 2027 winter block looks not yet loaded). A January-March booking the engine accepts may be cancelled.
